## 0010 — Checkpoint replacement ignores durability failures

- S0 / Tier A / START / L2/L4 persistent data
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:336-372
- Evidence before: writeCheckpoint ignores fallback fsync result at 359; ignores directory open failure and directory fsync result at 367–371, then returns success. A failed data barrier does not prevent rename of the replacement.

## 0011 — Prevent actor reentrancy from clearing unsynced append accounting

- S1 / Tier A / START / L2 concurrency
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:132-150,188-207
- Evidence before: performBarrier awaits a blocking queue then sets pendingSinceSync to zero if descriptor unchanged. Actor can accept append while suspended; those records may be written after barrier syscall but before completion. Comment claiming appends queue behind the await is not a Swift actor guarantee.

## 0012 — Establish serialization of append versus compaction

- S1 / Tier A / OPEN / L2 concurrency / data loss risk
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:294-329,105-124
- Evidence before: compact awaits a checkpoint replacement on a blocking queue; append writes to existing descriptor. Unless every caller provides external serialization, an append during suspension may land on the old inode and disappear after reopen. Caller contract not yet established.

## 0013 — Propagate asynchronous journal durability failures

- S1 / Tier A / START / L2 error propagation
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:140-146,393-400
- Evidence before: Scheduled performBarrier uses try?; shutDown also discards errors from settleBarrier and performBarrier before closing and releasing lock, despite async throws signature.

## 0014 — Distinguish corrupt complete journal records from torn tail

- S1 / Tier A / START / L3 persistent integrity
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:273-289
- Evidence before: decodeRecords silently drops every complete line whose JSON decoding fails, not just a final unterminated tail; no diagnostic is returned. Corruption or incompatible records may be lost before compaction.

## 0015 — Validate journal file type, ownership and permissions

- S1 / Tier A / OPEN / L4 filesystem boundary
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/FileJournal+Opening.swift:40-79; sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/Journal.swift:251-270
- Evidence before: O_NOFOLLOW and 0600 apply to final write path/creation, but existing file mode/type is not checked in shown openers; readContents follows final symlinks and reads until EOF. Parent-directory symlinks are intentional. Determine whether untrusted workspaces can supply FIFO, device, hardlink or permissive files.

## 0016 — Handle short pread during tail repair without truncating unread bytes

- S1 / Tier A / START / L3 data integrity
- Project: ContinuityCore; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/ContinuityCore/Persistence/FileJournal+Opening.swift:105-129
- Evidence before: Tail repair accepts any nonnegative read length, searches only the returned prefix, then sets end to offset, skipping an unread suffix if a short read occurs. Subsequent ftruncate may discard a complete record.

## 0017 — Bound HTTP header buffering before decoder completes

- S1 / Tier A / START / L4 resource exhaustion
- Project: TinyTitanServer; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/TinyTitanServer/Core/HTTPServer.swift:20-37,102-120
- Evidence before: Source explicitly acknowledges NIO accumulates unbounded small headers before application aggregate-limit checks. Pipeline config has no earlier aggregate bound. Server binds loopback, limiting exposure but not local denial of service.

## 0018 — Bound stored response memory by bytes and chain size

- S1 / Tier A / START / L5 resource exhaustion
- Project: TinyTitanServer; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: sources/TinyTitanServer/Core/ResponsesAPIStore.swift:17-54; sources/TinyTitanServer/Core/HTTPServerHandler+Responses.swift:43-53,70-87
- Evidence before: ResponseStore caps number of entries, not bytes; each continuation flattens prior conversation into storedInput, and entries retain input/output plus response JSON. A count cap does not bound accumulated history byte size. Generation context limits may reduce practical impact; measure.

## 0022 — Prove C reader offset bounds and destruction versus active batch lifecycle

- S1 / Tier A / OPEN / L2/L4 native interop
- Project: TinyTitanKernelsC; host: Apple Silicon Mac A

## 0024 — Make settings rewrite atomic and detect concurrent updates

- S1 / Tier A / DONE / L2 persistent config
- Project: DSH plugin; host: Linux primary B
- Location: plugins/dsh-tinytitan/src/generate.js:346-379
- Evidence before: Read settings then optional copy backup followed by writeFileSync directly to target. Interrupted write can truncate user profile; concurrent editor changes after read can be overwritten. Backup does not make replacement atomic.
- Evidence after: One atomic replacement path for the route writer and default repair: exclusive same-directory temp, fchmod to the original mode, fsync, re-read CAS (ESETTINGSCHANGED), collision-free backup, rename; injectable io seam. 5 RED tests -> green.

## 0030 — Test targets accept concurrency warnings despite warnings-as-errors

- S2 / Tier C / OPEN / language-standard / diagnostics
- Project: Root SwiftPM / tests; host: Apple Silicon Mac A

## 0034 — Catalog row normalization is not idempotent and its contract is unnamed

- S2 / Tier A / OPEN / L3 API contract / hollow test risk
- Project: DSH plugin; host: Linux primary B
- Location: plugins/dsh-tinytitan/src/generate.js:206,260

The two row shapes remain unnamed in the API, so a future caller can repeat the mistake.

## 0036 — Example fixtures bind to the checkout directory name

- S2 / Tier C / OPEN / portability / build configuration
- Project: Embedded and plugin examples; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: examples/embedded/Package.swift:43; examples/plugin/Package.swift:39,47
- Evidence before: The fixtures declare `.package(path: "../..")` and reference it as `package: "TinyTitan"`. SwiftPM names a path dependency after the directory basename, so any clone or git worktree whose directory is not literally `TinyTitan` fails with `unknown package 'TinyTitan' ... valid packages are: 'examples'`. The prescribed `swift build --package-path examples/...` cannot run in such a checkout before any change.

## 0038 — Manifest dependency declarations diverge from actual imports

- S3 / Tier C / OPEN / build hygiene
- Project: Root SwiftPM / manifests; host: Apple Silicon Mac A
- Location: Package.swift: TinyTitanServer, Qwen35Dense*, TinyTitanLib targets
- Evidence before: The source-derived graph in AUDIT/contracts.md shows TinyTitanServer imports TinyTitanCore, TinyTitanLegacyEngine, TinyTitanLib and TinyTitanMemory without declaring them directly (they arrive through TinyTitanServerCore), while the six Qwen35Dense* targets and TinyTitanLib declare TinyTitanFormat with no direct import. The build succeeds today; the declarations are fragile/unused rather than failing.
